row:
Southern Pines’ purpose is to nurture the bond between people and pets through community, compassion, and collaboration to forge a path toward sustainable, responsible, and community-driven lifesaving.

Southern Pines Animal Shelter is a nonprofit animal welfare organization in Hattiesburg, MS. In 2021, Southern Pines Animal Shelter achieved a Lifesaving Rate of over 97.87% thanks to the support of our community and state. Join us as we continue saving more lives than ever before by adopting, fostering, volunteering, and donating.

We're located at: 
1901 N 31st Ave
Hattiesburg, MS 39401

Hours of operation:
Monday - Tuesday:  12pm - 5pm
Wednesday:  CLOSED
Thursday - Sunday:  12pm - 5pm
